claims.statement: Tom Allen returned to St. Louis from Jacksonville, Florida, by the L. & N. railroad on the morning of 1894-01-27, the only one of the St. Louis sports to make the trip home that day.
claims.excerpt: arrived home this morning over the L. & N.

claims.statement: Tom Allen lost a diamond ring on the train home from Jacksonville, and later found it by the glitter of a piece of wire from a beer bottle.
claims.excerpt: Say, cawn’t you see I’ve lost me diamond
places: train from Jacksonville, Florida to St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen had prepared his famous ox-tail jelly as a stomach hardener for Charley Mitchell before the Corbett fight.
claims.excerpt: which he had prepared for Charley Mitchell, with the Intention of throwing it out the car

claims.statement: Tom Allen said there was no fight between Corbett and Mitchell.
claims.excerpt: Foight! Foight! There was no fight,’’ was the answer, as Alien searched his pock-

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Foight! Foight! There was no fight

notes: The hint that Allen had picked Mitchell to win is not in this article; it is supported by the 161 article, so it is not claimed here. Allen's dreams are minor and omitted. The reporter's account says Allen was in Florida; the dates come from the printed date.
